startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: DHgate product or store URLs to check. Each URL is classified automatically (product vs store) unless you override it with the Mode field.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to check: product listings or seller/store pages. Applies to every URL in this run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of URLs checked in parallel.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Safety cap on total requests (including retries). 0 = unlimited.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. DHgate usually works without a proxy; enable only if you hit blocks.
